cohort: The study included 430 publicly funded women with placenta praevia after 24 weeks gestation, admitted to a single tertiary hospital between 2007 and 2021, excluding multiple pregnancies, fetal abnormalities, intra-uterine fetal death, and deliveries at other hospitals.
finding: Higher numbers of previous caesarean sections, parity, Caucasian ethnicity, and major placenta praevia were independently associated with antepartum haemorrhage (APH) admission and premature delivery in women with placenta praevia, with affected babies more likely to require nursery admission.
